title: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia. And, Rep. Gomez resigns amid alleged sexual misconduct
summary: President Trump took credit for negotiating Jensen Huang's return as CEO of Nvidia. And, Rep. Jimmy Gomez, D-Calif., says his resignation will be effective Dec. 1.
content: President Trump took credit for negotiating Jensen Huang's return as CEO of Nvidia. And, Rep. Jimmy Gomez, D-Calif., says his resignation will be effective Dec. 1. (Image credit: Angela Weiss)
